clips.name: idle_breathe
clips.description: Default loop: slow float bob, rippling tail, drifting arms, one blink.

clips.name: idle_look_left_right
clips.description: Eyes glance left, hold, then right; body leans with them.

clips.name: idle_yawn
clips.description: Big yawn: stretches tall, then squishes back.

clips.name: idle_stretch
clips.description: Nub arms up overhead, body stretches taller, tail wisps fan out.

clips.name: idle_fade_blink
clips.description: Slowly fades to ~40%, notices, pops back to full with a startled blink.

clips.name: idle_lazy_drift
clips.description: Lazy figure-eight drift while humming with a small smile.

clips.name: sleep_fall_asleep
clips.description: Eyes droop, sinks lower, curls its tail around itself like a blanket.

clips.name: sleep_loop
clips.description: Floats low, slow breathing, glow pulse 85-100%, rising z z z, snot bubble.

clips.name: sleep_wake_up
clips.description: Bubble pops, shoots upward startled, two quick blinks, settles into the float.

clips.name: move_walk
clips.description: Glides forward in place (facing right), leaning in, tail streaming behind.

clips.name: move_hop
clips.description: Dips down, zooms up with arms raised, squashes softly back into the float.

clips.name: move_phase
clips.description: Fades out completely, reappears in the same spot with a sparkle puff.

clips.name: move_fall_land
clips.description: Drops in from above flailing, balloon-bounces twice, settles with dizzy stars.

clips.name: int_dragged
clips.description: Held by the tail tip (grab point 264,427): stretched like taffy, wobbly scared mouth, arms flailing.

clips.name: int_petted
clips.description: Happy ^ ^ eyes, rosier cheeks, wiggles into the hand, hearts pop up.

clips.name: int_poked
clips.description: Jelly wobble, puffed cheeks, angry brows, anger mark, then half see-through with a smug look.

clips.name: int_tickled
clips.description: Giggles and wriggles, eyes squeezed shut, tail wisps curling.

clips.name: int_look_up
clips.description: Eyes held looking up with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_up_right
clips.description: Eyes held looking up-right with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_right
clips.description: Eyes held looking right with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_down_right
clips.description: Eyes held looking down-right with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_down
clips.description: Eyes held looking down with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_down_left
clips.description: Eyes held looking down-left with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_left
clips.description: Eyes held looking left with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: int_look_up_left
clips.description: Eyes held looking up-left with the float bob (cursor following).

clips.name: mood_happy
clips.description: Twirls in a little circle with sparkles, happy ^ ^ eyes.

clips.name: mood_sad
clips.description: Sinks low, droopy tail, fades to 70%, teardrop.

clips.name: mood_surprised
clips.description: Puffs up bigger, round eyes, "o" mouth, "!" mark.

clips.name: mood_scared
clips.description: Shivers, wobbly mouth, worried brows, then hides its face behind its tail.

clips.name: mood_hungry
clips.description: Rubs its tummy, thought bubble with a toasted marshmallow.

clips.name: mood_love
clips.description: Heart eyes, body tints pale pink (flat colour swap), floating hearts.

clips.name: mood_smile_wink
clips.description: Big open smile with tongue, playful wink with a sparkle.

clips.name: fun_boo
clips.description: Dips out of view at the bottom, pops up with arms raised and a big BOO, then giggles.

clips.name: fun_spin
clips.description: Fast corkscrew spin with the tail whipping around, then a dizzy wobble.

clips.name: fun_peek
clips.description: Fades in halfway through the right edge, peeks, blinks, fades out.

clips.name: fun_notify
clips.description: Holds up the lantern under a round yellow "!" badge, flame flickering, happy open mouth.

clips.name: fun_lantern_glow
clips.description: Lights the lantern, face glows warm, looks around, then blows the flame out.
